modalities.evidence: raw 3T and 7T anatomical and functional MRI data
In fMRI runs, participants performed a block design visual task

output.population: 1 phantom and 8 human subjects (5 subjects at 3T and 3 subjects at 7T); healthy controls
output.summary: Raw 3T and 7T anatomical and functional MRI acquired with and without a conductive-ink polymer-thick-film EEG net, compared against a conventional copper wire net, including a flickering checkerboard visual task at 7T.
